tips.text: Collect the two Argon Crystals last and start the foundry the same day, because uncrafted crystals lose half at each daily reset.
Farm Polymer Bundle on Uranus first, then Mars for Salvage and Morphics together, then the Void for Argon, then craft.
Treat Akzani as an easy Mastery pickup; players point to other akimbo pistols for actual use.
